answer: A behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities: each agent locks a 300-unit bond that unlocks only after 20 epochs of consistent work, like a willow growing one ring at a time. A sudden delta in behavior, new devices or peers, freezes the bond and triggers a peer check, while steady agents pass under the lantern of public history. Forging 1,000 identities costs 300,000 units, versus 300 for one honest agent, who earns undiluted rewards.
